History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports a 3-day history of diarrhoea.
Stools are watery.
She has a sense of urgency with bowel movements.
There is no blood in the stool.
Patient experiences periumbilical abdominal cramps that come in waves.
Abdominal cramps worsen when she needs to open her bowels.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Worse when needs to open bowels.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: She has had four bowel movements by midday today.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Very regular BO, today already 4 x by midday.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has been vomiting.
She feels she is not keeping fluids down.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doesn't feel like she is holding down fluid.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: She is still passing urine, last void one hour ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Still PUing ok. Last 1 hr ago. Not sure of colour.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Her normal bowel habit is once per day.
She has not travelled abroad recently.
Patient’s brother recently had similar gastrointestinal symptoms.
Patient’s mother also had similar symptoms and patient was in contact with her.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Mother also had similar symptoms - patient was in contact with her.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: She has been taking oral rehydration therapy regularly but has difficulty keeping it down.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has been taking ORT regularly, difficulty keeping down.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports no rash.
She feels hot but has not checked her temperature.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Feels hot but hasn't checked temperature.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Last menstrual period was two weeks ago.
She does not have regular sexual intercourse.
She is not using contraception.
She had been at work until today and is now working from home.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has been at work til today. Now working from home.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has no significant past medical history.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with her brother and mother.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: SH: Lives with brother and mother.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks approximately one pint of alcohol per week.
Patient works as a graphic designer.

Family_History.content: Brother recently experienced similar gastrointestinal symptoms.
Mother also experienced similar gastrointestinal symptoms.
Family_History.source_text: Mother also had similar symptoms - patient was in contact with her.

Assessment.content: Impression is gastroenteritis, likely viral or food-related.

Plan_of_Care.content: If fever persists, a stool culture will be sent to exclude bacterial infection.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: As ongoing, fever needs stool culture sent to exclude bacterial origin.

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient advised to continue taking small sips of oral rehydration solution constantly.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advised to continue taking small sips ORT constantly.

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient advised to avoid fruits, vegetables, and milk for now.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advised to avoid fruits, vegetables, and milk for now.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient booked for an urgent appointment to assess hydration status.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Booked for urgent appointment to assess hydration status.

Follow_up_Information.content: If her condition worsens, develops abdominal pain, or feels unwell, she should contact the clinic for urgent A&E assessment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If feels worse in meantime, abdo pain, unwell to contact us to arrange urgent A&E assessment.
